fields.name: id
fields.coerce: none: used as an object key. The server looks in the monsters of your instance, then its characters, then its NPCs (`NPC_prefix + id`). It stores the raw value in `player.target`, so a number stays a number
fields.description: The new target: a monster id, a character name, or an NPC id without the NPC prefix. If nothing in your instance has this id (also when it is missing or `null`), the target becomes `null`.

fields.name: xid
fields.description: The new focus entity, by the same rules. If nothing in your instance has this id, the focus becomes `null`.

responses.name: Update
responses.summary: Your character with the new `target` and `focus` (`u+nc`: the server does not recalculate your stats).

responses.name: Success
responses.when: All checks pass. Also when an id matched nothing: the target (or focus) is then `null`, with no failure.

rows.when: In the GM map `cgallery`: the focus is a cosmetic NPC that is not a body, and `player.cx.length > 5`. `player.cx` is an object without `length`, so this does not occur in practice.

also.when: In `cgallery` only: the focus is a cosmetic NPC. The server shows that cosmetic on you (`tskin` or `tcx`) and sends this update before the usual one.
also.summary: Your character with the cosmetic preview.

order: `player` to you (one more before it in `cgallery`)
